method: Fresh production cars naturally launch from rest with raw throttle held at 1 through RCCP OverrideInputs/Update. Target entry speeds 80/100/120 km/h, left/right full steering, stock/L3; each independent measurement holds steering from 0.5 to 4.5 seconds, then observes straight recovery to 9 seconds. FormulaTractionControl alone owns traction intervention. No velocity/pose writes after spawn or experimental throttle cuts. One stock 100 km/h right-turn case has only FormulaTractionControl disabled and is excluded from handling acceptance. Fixed-step summaries, 0.1-second raw WheelHit traces (FL,FR,RL,RR), chosen frame-rate target reported separately. Isolated save and restored Editor settings.
acceptance: Production: body slip <20 degrees, all four wheels grounded, requested-direction heading at steering release >20 degrees, >60m travel and forward progress, final speed >30 km/h, raw throttle follows the requested input. At the end, torque scale >=95%, body slip <3 degrees, yaw <5 deg/s, and these conditions hold for the final continuous 0.3 seconds. Engine maximum torque must remain within 0.01 Nm of its authored value. Stock matrix 0-100 launch must remain within baseline*1.10+0.15s. Baseline spin is diagnostic only.
